title: 1 Beaten-Down Semiconductor Stock That Could Make a Comeback
excerpt: Intel has delivered its strongest revenue growth in fifteen years and rewarded patient investors with a massive run, yet the stock just shed nearly a third o...
content_html:
Quick Read

  • INTC surged 144% year to date but pulled back 29% in one month due to profit-taking and valuation, not deteriorating fundamentals.

  • Lip-Bu Tan called Q2 Intel's strongest revenue growth in fifteen years, fueled by a 59% Data Center and AI surge.

  • Hitting $135 by end of 2026 demands 50% upside and requires DCAI growth, solid 18A yields, and narrowing Foundry losses to all align.

  • Don't wait: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just revealed his top 10 AI stocks. See the full list FREE now.

Intel (NASDAQ:INTC) is my kind of comeback story right now. The $16.13 billion Q2 print, the 59% Data Center and AI surge, and Lip-Bu Tan's line that this was "our strongest revenue growth in more than fifteen years" tell you the operational story is real. But the tape is telling a very different story.

Intel is up 144.44% year to date, yet the stock just gave back nearly a third of its value in a month. Can INTC climb to $135 by the end of 2026?

The Real Reason Intel Is Down 28.99% This Month

The pullback reflects positioning and valuation after a monster year, rather than any deterioration in fundamentals. Intel is down 2.3% over the past week and 28.99% in the past month after a 355.56% one-year rip. With a beta of 2.19, this stock swings hard in both directions.

Sector-wide selling dragged INTC down with it. Add a headline noting the stock had sunk 40% from its peak and you get a textbook consolidation on top of a huge run. Bad tape, not bad business.

Wall Street Sees 27.79% Upside. Our Model Says Less

Consensus target sits at $115.27, roughly 27.79% above spot. The breakdown: 2 Strong Buy, 11 Buy, 32 Hold, 2 Sell, 2 Strong Sell. Our base case lands at $101.20 (12.19% upside) with an optimistic scenario of $117.82 and a bear case of $76.06, at 90% confidence.

Don't wait: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just revealed his top 10 AI stocks. See the full list FREE now.

Analysts correctly see continued AI-driven strength, but only 27% of ratings are bullish, which tells me sell-side desks are still calibrating to a company that has beaten estimates for six straight quarters. That is where the asymmetry lives.

The Path to $135 Per Share

Reaching $135 from today's price of $90.20 would require a gain of 49.7%. With forward EPS of $1.14, a price of $135 implies a forward P/E of 118x. Our base case of $101.20 already implies 83x, meaning the bold target requires 36x of additional multiple expansion. The setup exists.

Wells Fargo flagged a 48% jump in Xeon average selling prices and a 56% Data Center and AI gross margin. Intel also certified Synopsys and Keysight tools for its 14A and 18A-P nodes, shortening customer time-to-market.

英特尔（纳斯达克股票代码：INTC）是我现在的卷土重来的故事。 第二季度 161.3 亿美元的业绩、59% 的数据中心和人工智能激增，以及 Lip-Bu Tan 所说的“这是我们 15 年来最强劲的收入增长”，告诉您运营故事是真实的。 但磁带讲述的是一个截然不同的故事。

英特尔今年迄今已上涨 144.44%，但该股在一个月内就回吐了近三分之一的价值。 到 2026 年底，INTC 能否攀升至 135 美元？

英特尔本月股价下跌 28.99% 的真正原因

此次回调反映了经历了巨大的一年之后的定位和估值，而不是基本面的任何恶化。 英特尔在一年内下跌 355.56% 后，过去一周下跌 2.3%，上个月下跌 28.99%。 该股票的贝塔值为 2.19，双向波动剧烈。

整个行业的抛售拖累了 INTC 的下跌。 添加一个标题，指出该股已从峰值下跌 40%，在大幅上涨的基础上，你会看到教科书般的盘整。 糟糕的磁带，并不是糟糕的生意。

华尔街上涨 27.79%。 我们的模型说得更少

一致目标价为 115.27 美元，较现货价高出约 27.79%。 细分：2 家强力买入、11 家买入、32 家持有、2 家卖出、2 家强力卖出。 我们的基本假设为 101.20 美元（上涨 12.19%），乐观假设为 117.82 美元，悲观假设为 76.06 美元，置信度为 90%。

分析师正确地看到了人工智能驱动的持续强势，但只有 27% 的评级是看涨的，这告诉我，卖方部门仍在针对一家连续六个季度超出预期的公司进行调整。 这就是不对称性所在。

通往每股 135 美元的道路

从今天的 90.20 美元价格升至 135 美元需要上涨 49.7%。 远期每股收益为 1.14 美元，135 美元的价格意味着远期市盈率为 118 倍。 我们 101.20 美元的基本情况已经意味着 83 倍，这意味着大胆的目标需要 36 倍的额外倍数扩展。 该设置已存在。

富国银行 (Wells Fargo) 表示，Xeon 平均售价上涨了 48%，数据中心和人工智能毛利率上涨了 56%。 英特尔还为其 14A 和 18A-P 节点认证了 Synopsys 和 Keysight 工具，从而缩短了客户的上市时间。
